whatIs: Figma Motion is Figma's tool for creating animations directly on the canvas, with presets, keyframes with Bézier curves and springs, and an AI agent that generates motion from a description. Animations export as MP4, GIF, SVG or WebM.
It's a good fit when you design interfaces in Figma and want to define the motion right there and hand it off to the development team.
uses: Prototype a screen's entrance animation before coding it.
Hand developers the motion timeline and copy the code as CSS, JSON or React from Dev Mode.
Export an animation as GIF or MP4 for a presentation or a post.
caveats: It's in open beta and requires a Full seat; you can use it on the free Starter plan, but publishing animated components, generating with the AI agent and exporting high-resolution video require a paid Full seat.
Features such as custom presets, 3D transforms and full transitions between screens are still listed as coming soon.
Dev and Collab seats don't include it, which matters if your team only reviews designs.
pricingNote: Motion beta works with a Full seat, including on the free plan; the AI agent and high-resolution export require a paid Full seat, starting at $16 per month.
idealFor: Teams that design in Figma and want to define motion there.
